description: This file contains React components for rendering context menus, including Menu, MenuPresenter, and LazyLoader, with related subcomponents and hooks for menu interactions and positioning within the Notesnook project.

methods.name: Menu
methods.description: Main component rendering a context menu with items, handling focus, submenus, and actions.

methods.name: MenuPresenter
methods.description: Component that wraps Menu with popup presentation logic, handling open/close and positioning.

methods.name: LazyLoader
methods.description: Component for asynchronously loading menu items and rendering them.
